description: This file defines the ConfirmEmailModel class which handles email confirmation logic within the Razor Pages framework for the Identity area of the web application. It includes methods for confirming a user's email via user ID and confirmation code.

classes.name: ConfirmEmailModel
classes.description: PageModel for handling email confirmation in the Identity area.

methods.name: OnGetAsync
methods.description: Handles GET requests to confirm a user's email by verifying user ID and confirmation code, and updating the email confirmation status.
